title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - GPSUnit
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/GPSUnit. Definition of a geographical point (degrees/minutes/seconds representation).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GPSUnit'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

degrees.description: Property. Degrees component of the geographical point.

minutes.description: Property. Minutes component of the geographical point.

seconds.description: Property. Seconds component of the geographical point.

decimals.description: Property. Decimal fraction component of the geographical point.
